def seek(self, index):
        self._index = index
        remainder = index - len(self._cache)
        if remainder > 0:
            consume(self, remainder)

    def relative_seek(self, offset):
        """Seek relative to the current position.

        A positive offset moves forward, while a negative offset moves backward.

        >>> it = seekable(range(10))
        >>> next(it), next(it), next(it)
        (0, 1, 2)
        >>> it.relative_seek(-1)
        >>> next(it)
        1
        >>> it.relative_seek(2)
        >>> next(it)
        4

        Raises ``ValueError`` if attempting to seek before the beginning of the cache.
        """
        if self._index is None:
            current_pos = len(self._cache)
        else:
            current_pos = self._index
        new_pos = current_pos + offset
        if new_pos < 0:
            raise ValueError("Cannot seek before the beginning of the cache")
        self._index = new_pos
        if new_pos > len(self._cache):
            consume(self, new_pos - len(self._cache))
